title: Tanker Shipping - November 17, 2026
summary: Sentiment-Driven Correction Meets Improving Vessel Supply - Crude tanker Short-term Indicators freight has corrected sharply from October's unprecedented highs, initially Momentum: Negative driven by changing geopolitical sentiment following the US midterm elections. Expectations of de-escalation weakened freight sentiment, although the subsequent Sentiment: Neutral decline has increasingly been supported by changes in physical market conditions. Fundamentals: Positive Improving crude availability and rising inventories have reduced refiners' urgency to secure cargoes, while the resumption of Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline Breakwave Tanker operations has allowed tanker positioning to adjust to more established trading 11759 Futures Index: patterns.
